aoi.name: jordan_forest_belt
aoi.label: Northern Jordan forest belt (Irbid, Ajloun, Jerash)

body.metric_label: fire cell-days (0.01° cells with ≥1 kept detection)

sensors.note: Morning orbit (daytime passes near 09:00-10:30 local time): not comparable with the afternoon headline series.
Drifting orbit from 2022 (designed for 13:30). Before 2022 it is the headline reference.

harmonized.label: Aqua-equivalent (Aqua-MODIS, afternoon overpass)
harmonized.band_note: 90% range from out-of-sample tests, for weekly totals
caveats: Estimate of what Aqua-MODIS would have counted at its original afternoon overpass, from VIIRS. Years when Aqua flew its original orbit show Aqua observed instead.
Out-of-sample monthly error of the estimate: -30% to +8%.

notes: Each sensor is shown separately; counts from different sensors are never added.
Counts are of kept detections: nominal/high confidence vegetation fires.
null = no data (sensor not operational, outage, or outside the data range), never zero fire.
Partial periods (marked with a bar) count only the days with data; they are never complete totals.
Clouds hide fires and are not mapped: a low count can mean cloud, not absence of fire.
The AOI is the set of 0.25° cells whose centre lies inside the box.
